name: wiki-langgraph-research-v2
description: Updated evaluation cases for grounded research after the v0.5 knowledge-gap review release.

input.question: How should this application maintain repeatable Langfuse evaluations for research quality?
source_notes: Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals
Langfuse Evaluation Baseline and Trace Findings

themes: Keep versioned dataset definitions reviewable in the repository.
Use hosted datasets for comparable Langfuse experiment runs and local data for development.
Measure response structure, source grounding, theme coverage, and uncertainty.
Inspect exact traces and scores before accepting a run as a baseline.
gaps: Blocking score thresholds still require calibration against reviewed examples.

input.question: What should a durable session-research note contain, and why should raw transcripts remain outside the wiki corpus?
source_notes: Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals

themes: Record purpose, decisions, evidence, verification, open questions, and follow-ups.
Preserve source session identifiers when available.
Curated notes improve retrieval, provenance, and evaluation explainability.
Exclude secrets, raw environment values, and uncurated transcripts.
gaps: Not every manually authored note has a stable source session identifier.

input.question: How are LangGraph, the bounded agent, Deep Agents, and knowledge-gap review divided in this application?

themes: LangGraph owns deterministic ingest, compile, index, and lint execution.
The bounded agent performs inspect, plan, act, verify, and replan with an iteration limit.
Deep Agents remain opt-in, read-only reviewers rather than part of normal compilation.
Knowledge-gap review is advisory and does not approve candidates or mutate the corpus.
gaps: Knowledge-gap finding quality still needs dataset-backed calibration.

input.question: Which safeguards make wiki research and agent experiments reproducible?

themes: Pin the corpus root and isolate raw and compiled directories.
Use temporary fixture workspaces for agent evaluations.
Record dataset version, experiment name, model, commit, and source identifiers.
Keep generated outputs outside the source corpus to prevent retrieval contamination.
gaps: Continuous integration regression thresholds have not been finalized.

input.question: How should results from ongoing Langfuse experiments be interpreted after the initial baseline?
source_notes: Langfuse Evaluation Baseline and Trace Findings
Research Brief - Session Notes to Langfuse Evals

themes: Compare runs only when dataset, corpus, model, and configuration are known.
Treat configuration failures and wrong-model runs as diagnostics rather than baselines.
Inspect failed items and nested observations before changing prompts or thresholds.
Retain older dataset versions so historical comparisons remain meaningful.
gaps: A calibrated human-reviewed acceptance threshold is not yet available.

input.question: What evidence and safety properties should a trustworthy knowledge-gap review demonstrate?

themes: Findings should cite inspected allowlisted files and affected logical paths.
Duplicate or conflict claims require evidence from multiple notes and explicit uncertainty.
Review scope and omitted notes must be visible when coverage is partial.
The review must not write notes, manifests, indexes, or candidate decisions.
gaps: Category-level precision and recall need calibration on curated fixtures.
